The independent practice

Care on every page.

Kodryn focuses on publication systems: typography, page hierarchy, visual direction and clear communication. The portfolio is a collection of self-initiated studies, not a list of commissioned clients.

Design and production

Adobe InDesign layouts, editable source files and PDF delivery can be scoped for print or screen. Final print specifications, linked assets and usage rights are agreed per project.

A clear working process

Brief and content review, visual direction, layout development, consolidated feedback and agreed file handover.

Evidence, not promises

Explore forty studies with source-derived publication previews, format specifications and original presentation boards.

Before you enquire

Good questions.

What to know before commissioning publication design.

What should I prepare?

Share draft copy, available imagery, brand guidelines, audience, estimated page count, deadline and intended format. We can discuss what is still missing.

Can I request editable files?

InDesign or IDML source, linked assets and PDF exports can be included in the agreed scope. Font and image licences are handled separately.

Can you prepare documents for print?

Print specifications, bleed, colour requirements and printer instructions are agreed before production. Screen PDFs can also be scoped.

Are these commissioned projects?

The 40 projects shown are self-initiated design studies. Illustrative data and fictional briefs are not client testimonials or commercial results.
